flawless: Hee hee! Not a scratch! Imps one, lumbering bigfolk nothing!
Flap flap, zap zap, and you're done. You should see your face!
solid: Ow, my wing! Worth it, worth it, hee!
You swatted at me plenty. Swatted mostly air, though!
close: Eep! You nearly squashed me flat. Don't tell the other imps.
My tail's still smoking! That was too close, too close, hee... hee...
